top.title: US proposes extra tariffs of up to 25% on Indian goods, 17% after trade deal
top.description: India faces an additional tariff of up to 25%, which can come down to 17% if both sides sign the proposed trade deal, according to the US Trade Representative. The US is India’s largest export market, accounting for shipments of goods worth over $87 billion in the fiscal year through March 2026.
